extracted_concepts.name: Linear Transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A map T: V → W satisfying additivity and homogeneity.

extracted_concepts.name: Additivity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: T(u + v) = T(u) + T(v).

extracted_concepts.name: Homogeneity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: T(cu) = cT(u).

extracted_concepts.name: Rotation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A linear transformation that rotates vectors in R² or R³.

extracted_concepts.name: Reflection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A linear transformation that reflects vectors in R² or R³.

extracted_concepts.name: Projection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A linear transformation that projects vectors onto a subspace.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The linear operator D(p) = p'.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operator p ↦ ∫₀ˣ p(t) dt.

extracted_concepts.name: Kernel
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ker(T) = {v ∈ V : T(v) = 0}.

extracted_concepts.name: Image
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Im(T) = {T(v) : v ∈ V}.

extracted_concepts.name: Rank-Nullity Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dim(Ker T) + dim(Im T) = dim(V).

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix Representation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A matrix A such that [T(v)]_B = A[v]_B.

extracted_concepts.name: Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A linearly independent spanning set for a vector space.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The coordinate array [v]_B relative to a basis B.

extracted_concepts.name: Composition of Transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Applying one linear transformation after another.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix Multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Multiplication of matrices representing composition.

extracted_concepts.name: Change of Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Replacing one basis by another to describe the same space.

extracted_concepts.name: Transition Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P satisfies [x]_B = P[x]_B'.

extracted_concepts.name: Similar Matrix Representation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The matrix in a new basis is A' = P^(-1) A P.

extracted_concepts.name: Inner Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A map ⟨u, v⟩ satisfying symmetry, linearity, and positive definiteness.

extracted_concepts.name: Dot Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ⟨u, v⟩ = u₁v₁ + u₂v₂ + ... + uₙvₙ in Rⁿ.

extracted_concepts.name: Linearity of Inner Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inner product is linear in its vector argument.

extracted_concepts.name: Positive Definiteness
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ⟨v, v⟩ ≥ 0, with equality only when v = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vectors u and v are orthogonal if ⟨u, v⟩ = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Gram-Schmidt Process
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Converts a basis into an orthonormal basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthonormal Basis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A basis whose vectors are mutually orthogonal unit vectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Least Squares Solution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x̂ = (A^T A)^(-1) A^T b gives the best approximate solution.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal Projection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Proj_W v = Σᵢ ⟨v, qᵢ⟩qᵢ for an orthonormal basis {qᵢ}.
